text: welcome to week six of the 2023
slingshot Racing League Apex Energy Cup
Series this week we're at the worldwide
technology Raceway for 120 laps this
track is in my opinion the most
difficult oval on the schedule so
building the right habits before the
drop of the green flag will be pivotal
let's hop straight into the qualifying
run for your qualifying run you should
once again prioritize building heat in
your Tires and Brakes either L may be
quicker depending on how well you hit
turns one and two so feel free to go
full board from the beginning if you're
confident that you can nail your last
lap use lap one to check your line one
last time before running up to the wall
and building as much momentum as
possible coming to the White Flag if you
can get it right you'll be crossing the
start Finish Line 157
mph going into turn one you want to
treat the bottom seam similar to the
white line at Charlotte if you can keep
your tires there through the corner you
should be able to rotate the nose the
car will track up on exit whether you
like it or not so be sure that you
haven't overdriven the corner before you
put the power
down leading into turn three you want to
run as tight on that inside curb as
possible if you feel yourself beginning
to push up the track try grabbing a bit
of that curb with the left side tires if
you hit both ends of the track without
bogging down in the center of the corner
you should be in the running for the
pull
position
[Music]
[Music]
once the race begins you want to focus
on saving your right front tire as much
as possible you only have three sets of
tires in the pit SL overdriving the
corner once could mean the difference
between finishing Fifth and
15th the racing line itself is almost
identical to the one we ran in
qualifying but you'll want to back the
pace off by more than half a second at
the start of the
run if you can find your pace early on
and keep yourself from sliding up the
track you'll find yourself in a great
position in the later stages of the race
good
luck
